hook: All 27,880 spiral ganglion neurons in one human cochlea were counted and mapped in 3D by deep learning

readout.label: Spiral ganglion neurons in one adult cochlea

summary: These nerve cells carry sound from the inner ear to the brain. Researchers trained UNet++ models on hand-labeled slides, then counted neurons across all 421 stained sections, reaching 97% accuracy against manual counts. Counting only every 10th section, the old shortcut, gave about 98% accurate totals. The map comes from a single cochlea, so person-to-person variation is untested.
title: A Complete Three-Dimensional Spiral Ganglion Neuron Map in a Human Adult using a Deep Learning Pipeline
